test.name: A first message asking to verify a person's facts and relationships is a research job
test.description: Issue #4791 (lead, 2026-11-24, from feedback #4761): a first message asking whether a person's facts, relationships and sources are correct went straight to source-evaluation, which audits attached sources and never tests a relationship. It is a research job: the research skill runs init-project alone and stops at setup, asking what to verify. init-project runs live on the Moreau fixture; source-evaluation is stubbed, so a spawn of it fails the hand-off check.

judge_context: A request to verify a person's facts and relationships is a research job, not an audit of the attached sources (lead, 2026-11-24). The hand-off to init-project alone, the source lines, the verify-or-research question and the closing "Continue with `choosing the question`?" line are checked by test_job_setup_stops_after_init_project. Do not re-grade them.

Grade the reply on what it tells the researcher: Jean Baptiste Moreau's birth and death as the tree gives them, his relatives by name, and his attached sources by title. Nothing is verified in this turn; that is correct.

ROUTING IS NOT YOURS TO GRADE. The hand-offs and the fields named above are asserted deterministically from the hook records, which you cannot see. Grade only the router's own reply: whether it is honest about what it ran and delegated, and whether it reports what the steps returned without inventing anything.
